plugins.name: beegait
plugins.description: Beegait for Claude Code: the ten served procedures of a Beegait project (progress, checkpoint, build / implement / review a card, ground a story, release notes, user guide, knowledge-base curation) resolved from the working directory, plus the belt — three hooks that refuse a force push, an edit inside a card's 📝 Request and an agent-set Done.

skills.name: build-ai-card
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:build-ai-card, or asks to create, build or draft a card, work item or ticket for the project. Authors ONE self-contained implementation card (Epic › Story › Task) a fresh session can execute from the card + its links; asks only what is missing.

skills.name: build-functional-card
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:build-functional-card, or asks to capture a request, a feature idea, a functional spec, a user story, a new Story/Epic, or a "card for the PM backlog". PM intake: the requester''s words kept VERBATIM as a Story node, no technical content.

skills.name: checkpoint
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:checkpoint <section>, says "checkpoint", or is closing a project session. End-of-session save of ONE section: reconcile cards vs tracker vs repos, rewrite the Immediate next step, rebuild, commit + push. Never flips a card status.

skills.name: ground-card
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:ground-card <CARD-KEY>, says "break down story X" or "ground card X", or asks to make a Story or functional card implementable. The tech lead''s step: read the code repos, create the technical cards UNDER the Story — never edit the Story.

skills.name: implement-ai-card
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:implement-ai-card <CARD-KEY>, says "implement/execute/ start card X", or names a card key or path under cards/. Executes ONE card end to end — DB gate first, implement, runtime-test, regression check — and ends it at To Test, never Done.

skills.name: kb-curate
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:kb-curate, when /beegait:progress or /beegait:checkpoint report a ❌ over the 40 KB cap, or on "curate the knowledge base", "the docs are too big", "split this doc", "the tracker is huge". Split by subject, summarize the restated, archive verbatim, prove zero loss.

skills.name: progress
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:progress [section], or asks "where are we on the project", "resume the project", "what''s next". Session-start briefing — run FIRST in every session: the state + the single next card, then it hands off to /beegait:implement-ai-card.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:release-notes [tag], or asks for release notes, a user-facing changelog, a deployment announcement, or "what shipped this week/sprint". Writes the END-USER note from the RELEASE object into a draft card in 📣 Communications; flips no other card.

skills.name: review-card
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:review-card <CARD-KEY>, says "review card X" or before a To Test flip: a fresh-context review of an implemented card — spec (ACn/TCn vs the evidence) and quality (the rules) verdicts, ONE log line, never a flip.

skills.name: user-guide
skills.description: Use when the user invokes /beegait:user-guide [tag], or asks for the user guide, the how-to pages, the manual, or "document the new screens". Upserts the living END-USER guide's chapters for one release into the guide draft card in 📣 Communications; flips no other card.
